integrity: The proof uses the NTPN density and Rényi theorem printed in the primary source. The theorem and its multinomial/binomial derivation were inspected in the full open-access PDF, including the rendered equation page. Independent direct quadrature and Gaussian-expectation calculations are supplementary consistency checks.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the real-order domain of the finite Rényi-entropy formula and does not re-evaluate its coefficients at positive integer orders.
The corrected all-real-order representation is exact but generally requires numerical quadrature at noninteger orders.
No claim is made about the Shannon limit at order one.
title: Rényi entropy for NTPN needs a real-order correction
